description: Madina provides Python tools for pedestrian and bicycle network analysis, including routable networks, accessibility measures and flow analysis. The provider is City Form Lab. Geographical and temporal coverage: The software works with user-supplied urban networks. It is preserved for reproducibility of the associated 2025 publication. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The repository explicitly says Madina has been superseded by UNA and directs new users to that successor. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-matsim, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
